item.description:
Sockystick 1.0.3

Sockystick 1.0.3 brings a refreshed squircle-filling app icon and an option to hide the Dock icon, allowing Sockystick to run exclusively in the menu bar.

  • Option for No Dock Icon: Configure Sockystick to run exclusively from the menu bar extra with the Dock icon hidden via Settings > General > Appearance.
  • Updated App Icon: High-fidelity icon tightly filling the macOS squircle without border or drop-shadow artifacts.
  • Seamless Window Activation: Starts quietly in the menu bar when the Dock icon is hidden, while opening windows from the menu bar brings them forward smoothly.

Sockystick 1.0.2

Sockystick 1.0.2 introduces automatic proxy teardown on application quit and brand new dynamic hockey stick menu bar icons.

  • Automatic Proxy Teardown on Quit: The system SOCKS5 proxy on active network interfaces is automatically disabled and the local authentication bridge is stopped whenever Sockystick terminates.
  • Dynamic Hockey Stick Menubar Icons: Custom vector icons showing a hockey stick when disconnected, and a hockey stick with a puck when connected and active.
  • Clean Menu Bar: Removed text labels for a minimalist, distraction-free menu bar presence.
  • Sparkle 2 Updates: EdDSA-signed automatic updates.

Sockystick 1.0.1

Sockystick 1.0.1 introduces an updated 3D app icon, local SOCKS5 authentication bridging for seamless browser compatibility, and Sparkle 2 updates.

  • Brand New App Icon: A 3D-rendered composite carbon fiber hockey stick with braided ethernet cable tape, glowing circuit bus routing, and an illuminated proxy router puck.
  • Local SOCKS5 Auth Bridge: Transparent RFC 1929 authentication bridge enabling full authenticated SOCKS5 proxy support in Safari and system apps without OS limitations.
  • Framed Socket Streaming: Non-blocking byte buffering and direct TLS Client Hello forwarding for responsive web browsing.
  • Sparkle 2 Updates: EdDSA-signed automatic updates.
